Indian media covers upcoming Hindu religious dates and observances

Several Indian media outlets are providing information on upcoming Hindu religious dates, specifically focusing on Somvati Amavasya, Ashadh Aniruddha Vinayak Chaturthi, Ashadh Amavasya, and Guru Purnima. The reports detail the specific dates, auspicious timings for rituals, and the religious significance of these observances, guiding readers on when and how to perform associated pujas and ceremonies.
